summary: Max Verstappen won the Austrian Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 21.0s ahead of Sergio Perez, with Carlos Sainz completing the podium.
Lewis Hamilton made the biggest climb, from P18 to P10.
Lando Norris had a day to forget, dropping from P3 to P9.
There were 11 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 0 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 70 points over Sergio Perez.
